items.title: Liquid Network Restores Bitcoin Backing After Major Hack
items.summary: Liquid Network has restored full Bitcoin backing for its LBTC tokens, marking a vital recovery milestone nearly two months after a security exploit drained $320 million from the Bitcoin sidechain. items.title: Bitcoin is breaking a midterm election pattern going back to 2014

items.summary: Bitcoin edged up 0.2% to around $76,900 since midnight UTC as spot ETFs lost $399 million for a second day and Binance customers pulled a net $4.72 billion.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
